purpose: source-and-version disclosure for every external public resource, as required by the 2026-08-11 handbook revision (merged open leaderboard) and by the new 5% open-source-contribution dimension

official_competition_data.resource: GOAI Track-3 virtual-cell dataset (4 files: metadata and proteome for train_val and test)
official_competition_data.licence: competition data-use agreement: used only within this competition, NOT redistributed; the repository ships readers and structural contract checks only
official_competition_data.note: sample counts and protein width independently reproduced by our QC (evidence/metadata_profile.json, evidence/qc_summary.json) and they agree with the revised handbook

resources.role: compound entity representation: canonical SMILES + CID for every chemical perturbation label
resources.version_or_access: PubChem PUG-REST, accessed 2026-08-05 during this project
resources.licence: PubChem aggregates contributor records whose licensing can vary; the service does not support a blanket public-domain claim. Check record-level provenance before redistribution
resources.verification: molecular weights cross-checked against the PubChem record for every resolved compound; salt stripping and parent-molecule extraction validated on 55 reference weights

resources.role: molecular descriptors, ECFP4 fingerprints, ETKDGv3 conformers and MMFF94-optimised 3D descriptors from the PubChem SMILES
resources.verification: 0 missing descriptor cells; independent molecular-weight cross-check caught two silent salt-stripping failures

resources.role: target binding potency (Kd/Ki/IC50/EC50) used to build the Inferred Target Potency Vector (ITPV)
resources.version_or_access: ChEMBL web services, accessed 2026-08-07; the exact database release was not retained in the original artefact
resources.licence: CC BY-SA 3.0; redistribution of regenerated derived tables or matrices must preserve the applicable attribution/share-alike terms
resources.verification: 12 pre-declared positive pharmacology controls (11 recovered) and 10 pre-declared negative controls (10 correctly zero); see evidence/step6_itpv_mechanism_validation.json

resources.resource: OrthoDB cross-references returned by UniProt REST
resources.role: orthology projection of non-yeast ChEMBL targets onto the measured yeast proteome axis; no direct OrthoDB API or bulk file was queried
resources.version_or_access: UniProt REST response accessed 2026-08-07; the underlying OrthoDB subrelease was not retained
resources.licence: the upstream OrthoDB terms/version were not captured in the original artefact; confirm them before redistributing mapped rows
resources.verification: rapamycin potency maps to FPR1 (FKBP12 homologue) rather than directly to TOR, which is the pharmacologically correct form

resources.role: accession and gene-symbol normalisation between ChEMBL targets and the yeast protein roster
resources.version_or_access: UniProt REST, accessed 2026-08-07; the response release header was not retained
resources.verification: symbol channel contributes only 148 of 1837 links, so a symbol collision cannot dominate the mapping

resources.role: protein association network: adjacency for the graph neural member, spectral embedding, and the protein functional clusters used by the hierarchical-shrinkage meta-learner
resources.verification: Jaccard overlap with the train-only co-response graph is 0.0324, so the external graph carries information complementary to the data itself rather than restating it

resources.role: literature-informed stoichiometric mass-balance penalty (core sub-network) in the mechanism loss; no third-party model file is read
resources.version_or_access: Mo, Palsson & Herrgard (2009) used as the literature reference for a hand-coded 44-reaction subset
resources.licence: citation-based reimplementation; no upstream model file is redistributed and no model-file licence is asserted
resources.verification: every reaction retained has at least one measured enzyme; the flux penalty was validated against an independent NumPy reference implementation

resources.role: co-complex consistency penalty in the mechanism loss; the code embeds a manual member roster rather than a database export
resources.version_or_access: manual roster documented against CORUM, Complex Portal and yeast-complex literature; per-edge provenance was not retained in the original artefact
resources.licence: no upstream database export is redistributed; upstream terms must be rechecked before replacing the manual roster with source records
resources.verification: each complex edge is weighted 1/(k-1) so that a large complex contributes in proportion to its subunit count rather than to its pair count

resources.role: PLANNED strain entity representation: variant-derived features for the unseen strain CRD (S2/S3 extrapolation)
resources.version_or_access: not yet used in any scored run; declared as the planned source for the next stage
resources.licence: not verified for redistribution in this project; confirm the specific file terms before use
resources.verification: NOT USED in any number reported in this submission; the submitted model treats strain identity as a categorical feature and therefore has no representation for CRD

resources.role: PLANNED proxy reference for DHY210, per the organisers' recommendation
resources.version_or_access: not yet used in any scored run
resources.licence: not verified for redistribution in this project; confirm the specific release terms before use
resources.verification: NOT USED in any number reported in this submission

commercial_apis_and_closed_models.used_for: script drafting and refactoring, literature search and DOI checking, figure generation, typesetting
commercial_apis_and_closed_models.reason: no assistant service participates in model training, inference or scoring; stochastic model stages pin seed 42, while non-random QC and disclosure outputs do not claim a seed field

commercial_apis_and_closed_models.used_for: a small number of purely conceptual schematics
commercial_apis_and_closed_models.reason: every figure that carries a numeric result is drawn by matplotlib directly from the result artefacts

commercial_apis_and_closed_models.item: online inference services for the model itself
commercial_apis_and_closed_models.reason: all training, inference and scoring run locally
